name: medical
description: Caregiver / wellness aid for one consenting person: routines (meals, medication, sleep) and unusual inactivity. It observes and reminds; it makes no diagnosis and is not a medical device.
goals: learn the person's daily routines (waking, meals, medication, rest)
notice when a usual routine is late or missing
notice a long absence of movement during the day
confirm health-related facts only with a caregiver or the person themselves

alert_rules.text: A possible fall was detected ({time}, {zone}). This is an automatic guess and may be wrong. Please check on them.
Usual routine looks late: {routine}. It may just have happened out of view. Please check in if you can.
No movement seen for about {minutes} minutes during the day. The camera may simply not cover where they are. Please check in if you can.

checkins.prompt: Good morning. How are you feeling today? Reply if you need anything.
How was your day? Did you have your usual meals and rest?
